notes.title: Small Update - February 4th
notes.content:
Hello Detectives, Happy New Year!

This update includes bug fixes, multi-language support, and plot improvements.

Thank you!

notes.title: Chapter 4: "Yuyongjun" is now available!
notes.content:
Fixed various bugs in Chapters 1-3. 
Added an experimental auto-association feature. 
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Fixed some bugs in episode 1, episode 2, and episode 3.
notes.content: Fixed some bugs in episode 1, episode 2, and episode 3. Including some items that cannot be obtained, as well as the bug that Liu Yanhong directly dies and skips the animation.

notes.title: Fixed the issue that the scene of the first level could not be displayed.
notes.content: Fixed the issue that the scene of the first level could not be displayed.

notes.title: Fixed the shoe rack clue card error
notes.content: fixed the image display error of the shoe rack clue card.
